flawed_step: The claimed bound leaves >= Delta(T)+2 is false; a tree is only guaranteed at least Delta(T) leaves (and at least 2).
counterexample: T = K2 (n=2): Delta(T)=1, number of leaves = 2 < 1+2 = 3. (Also any path P_n, 3<=n<=7: Delta=2, 2 leaves < 4.)
assessment_summary: K2 is a tree with n=2 in range, max degree 1, and exactly 2 leaves (per the given definition), but the statement requires at least 3 leaves. Paths P3..P7 also fail (2 leaves vs required 4). Statement is false.
